F01 required dependency repair.purpose: The conversational choice is followed by a host-verifiable recipe authorization. Cached checks do not convert failure into success.

F08 C3 custody approval before durable h.purpose: Eligibility probing is transient. Persisted custody starts only after scoped receipt validation. The temporary browser context closes after identity-matched generation commit.

F08b custody declined clears temporary c.purpose: No generation is committed when authorization is declined or the human leaves.

F09 mixed binding has browser write and.purpose: Distinct per-operation instances prevent a detachable read from granting detachable writes.

F10 refresh generation.purpose: The credential-family lock spans send through durable generation publication. Old and successor generations have separate identities. Business-error responses may still rotate auth state.

F10b ordinary response rotates.purpose: The credential-family lock spans send through durable generation publication. Old and successor generations have separate identities. Business-error responses may still rotate auth state.

F10c error response rotates.purpose: The credential-family lock spans send through durable generation publication. Old and successor generations have separate identities. Business-error responses may still rotate auth state.

F11 rotation crash before persistence pa.purpose: Do not retry a rotating refresh with stale material; business effects and credential persistence are separately ambiguous.

F14 authorized C4 re-harvest succeeds.purpose: The remembered profile and C4 authorization are retained explicitly; the original C3 approval alone is insufficient.

F15 hand-back commits browser owner befo.purpose: Both refreshers remain fenced during an interrupted transfer. The committed owner epoch decides who can resume.

F15b interrupted transfer reconciles bro.purpose: Broker generation stays recoverable; browser refresh remains fenced. No business attempt is replayed.

F17 approved write succeeds.purpose: Receipt consumption and dispatch journal commit are one runtime transaction under AD-10a; this scenario does not prove transaction atomicity.

F18a same-key idempotent retry succeeds.purpose: Retry has the original key and payload under a reviewed service idempotency contract. Settlement is once per same intent/key.

F18b same-key retry proves nonexecution.purpose: A clean failure must cover the entire original idempotent intent, not merely the retry request.

F18d correlated terminal nonexecution re.purpose: An absent status result alone does not establish nonexecution.

F26 challenged broker stops automatic fa.purpose: No edge permits automatic fallback from human_required; only explicit resolution or revocation can leave it.

F27 purge unsent work and configuration.purpose: A design inventory, not an exhaustive system snapshot. Runtime must enumerate all instances and verify each disposal; failed cleanup remains blocked.

F27b purge preserves ambiguous business.purpose: The unknown intent journal and pending reservation remain; secret material is removed separately. Uninstall must report this retained evidence explicitly.

F08c C4 authorization is separate.purpose: C4 requires both persistent custody approval and a separate active auto re-harvest authorization before the durable harvest. The profile is retained explicitly.

F28a unknown occurrence completes only a.purpose: An already-dispatched occurrence is reconciled, never queued as a fresh dispatch.

F28b unknown occurrence fails only after.purpose: An already-dispatched occurrence is reconciled, never queued as a fresh dispatch.

F15c revoked transfer never resumes eith.purpose: Revoking both owners cannot restore broker custody; remove it explicitly.

F27c purge cancels an unsent parked occu.purpose: An unsent parked occurrence can be cancelled; awaiting reconciliation is a different state.

F29 Web Link source install from an immu.purpose: HTTPS URL/ref/catalogPath are user configuration; the source reader resolves a single commit and verifies bounded regular blobs. Repository trust cannot become local trust or origin grants. For first install, expected-old is absent. Schema/path/digest validation and atomic CAS are normative runtime requirements, not implemented downloader behavior.

F30 source check failure retains approve.purpose: The approved local immutable snapshot remains usable. A source fetch, ref-resolution or catalog-validation failure does not invalidate its ManifestOp or change its installed digest.

F31 Web Link semantic update rejected an.purpose: Old installed and proposed operation instances are distinct. Rejecting new semantics deletes only candidate staging; the existing approved immutable install is unchanged.

F32 Web Link activation CAS failure pres.purpose: An approval cannot authorize overwriting a concurrently changed installed pointer. Registry CAS failure leaves the currently installed approved snapshot in place; no partial activation occurs.

F33 removing a source stops updates and.purpose: Source removal affects future checks and staged candidates only. Explicit Web Link retirement is separate and uses ManifestOp approved-to-retired; there is no implicit removal of pinned installations.

F34 unchanged semantic digest can update.purpose: The reviewed execution-semantic digest must be exactly unchanged and the old pin must still match. This path updates an immutable provenance pin without expanding trust, credentials, operations or grants. Runtime digest comparison and expected-old CAS remain mandatory.

F35 invalid Web Link blob rejected befor.purpose: Bad paths, schema failures, digest mismatch, unsupported Git modes or resource-limit failures never reach approval or activation. The installed snapshot remains unchanged.
